# Attribution

The domain-restricted definition of normal sequences, its restriction lemma,
and the one-point-compactification presentation of the Riemann sphere are
adapted from `ExpChaotic/Normality.lean` and `ExpChaotic/Spherical.lean` in
https://github.com/LR-UK/exp-chaotic (retrieved 16 September 2026).
